summary: Iteration 27 (Bloque 1 multi-país): backend + frontend testing. Backend 15/15 pytest tests pass (geo countries, helplines shape, register acquisition, onboarding multi-country, discover scopes). Frontend Playwright confirmed URL-param capture into localStorage.ps_acquisition on /registro and /login, CL verified helplines rendering with correct testids and country name 'Chile', 3 scope filter buttons in Discover, and me-tinca-btn shows 'Me tinca' for demo1 (CL).
critical_code_review_comments: Discover default scope is 'country' (line 30 of Discover.jsx). Regional/nearby require explicit user action — expected per PRD.
server.py exceeds 3500 lines; consider splitting geo/auth/discover routers into separate modules for maintainability.
Legacy `comuna` field in User model is used to store city for non-CL users (server.py:1276) — mildly confusing; a future migration to a single `city` field would clean this up.
test_credentials: Admin: contacto@sinadicciones.org / Jodorowsky100. Demo: demo1..demo12@plansobrio.cl / Demo1234!.
seed_data_creation: Test class creates one onboarded MX user (email `test_onb_<ts>@example.com`) for the regional discover scenario. All test emails use @example.com (regex on server rejects @plansobrio.test).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Register/onboarding accept ONLY email domains matching the server-side regex (which rejects .test TLDs). Use @example.com for test emails. Gender enum: femenino|masculino|no_binario|prefiero_no_decir (not F/M). Helplines endpoint shape is {country, verified, helplines} — Frontend NecesitoApoyo handles both new and legacy array shape. Discover default scope in UI is 'country'; the 'Filtros' button opens a panel exposing filter-scope-nearby/country/regional testids. NecesitoApoyo route is /app/necesito-apoyo (not /app/apoyo).
